risk.unreadableShell: Runs a shell, so what actually executes is inside the string
risk.deleteEverything: Deletes everything under a root or home path
risk.writeToDevice: Writes raw data to a device
risk.networkCodeAsRoot: Downloads code and hands it straight to a shell
risk.powerState: Shuts down or restarts the host
risk.databaseDrop: Drops a database or a table
risk.recursivePermissions: Changes permissions recursively from the root
risk.permissionsWideOpen: Makes a path writable by anyone
risk.versionControlDestructive: Discards version history or force-pushes over it
